summary: Practise HSE risk registers, operational controls, incident learning and audit evidence. Explore the five-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: Health, safety and environmental management links workplace hazards and environmental aspects to controls and evidence of performance. For HSE coordinators, operations supervisors and environmental officers, the course builds practical skills in prioritizing risks, selecting and verifying controls, and coordinating contractor and permit-to-work interfaces. Participants also practise documenting incident learning, tracking corrective actions and preparing audit evidence for operational review.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who coordinate workplace health, safety and environmental controls, investigate performance gaps or report HSE results. It is designed for roles that connect operational work with management-system evidence.
modules: Job Safety Analysis and Control Selection
HSE Performance Review and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working familiarity with workplace health and safety or environmental responsibilities is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring access to Excel for the action-tracking exercises where available.
